data.name: Jiten
data.gender_notes: Jiten is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Jiten is a Sanskrit and Hindi name meaning 'Conquerer, Victor'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'jit', meaning 'to conquer, to overcome'. This name is often given to a child who is expected to grow up and achieve great things, and to overcome any obstacles that may come his way. The name Jiten carries the meaning “Conquerer, Victor” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Jiten usually hope their child will grow to embody conquerer, victor and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Jiten is a name that symbolizes the power of the individual to overcome any challenge and achieve victory. It represents the inner strength and determination to conquer one's fears and desires, and to shine brightly in the world.
data.etymology: Jiten belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Conquerer, Victor.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jiten total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
